answer.main_body: copper-wound coil column with brass toroid and sphere terminal
answer.evidence: The brass toroid cap atop the column is drawn in clear 3/4 perspective, showing its top surface and recessed inner opening across rows 12-16 (approx. 4 rows deep). The base plinth also shows a curved top rim.

answer.main_body: copper coil tower with brass toroid
answer.evidence: The brass toroid ring capping the coil is drawn in clear 3/4 perspective with a 4-row visible top surface and a 3-row foreshortened elliptical inner opening (rows 13-15). The base plinth also displays its foreshortened top surface (rows 40-41).

answer.main_body: Tesla coil column with copper windings, brass toroid ring, top sphere, and base
answer.evidence: The Tesla coil is drawn in consistent 3/4 top-down perspective. The brass toroid ring (rows 12-16) clearly shows its top surface and recessed center hole (~4 rows), the coil windings are drawn with downward-curving elliptical bands, and the base plinth shows a visible top surface (rows 39-41, ~3 rows).

The main body is the tall copper-wound coil column (rows 18-39). It shows no top surface, and the top terminal orb/cylinder (rows 4-10) is also drawn flat with a 1px outline cap at row 4. While the brass ring and base plinth show 3/4 perspective, the main body itself lacks a visible top surface.
